seed: Two ways a Size measurement went wrong for someone redlining, found in the audits of 2026-10-13. At Next defaults, on the user's own download page crop: from the measured pill, ] stepped to a box from the pill's top down into the line of small print under it (it read 279 by 90); now there is nothing bigger that is a real object, so ] holds on the pill. And a picked Size measurement's corner handles sat out past its calipers and chips, so dragging one stretched everything (the pill's 274 by 62 became 315 by 78 for a drag of 100 by 50); now the handles sit on the measured box, the corner goes where the hand lets go, the calipers stay on the box's edges and read its new size, and the name follows.

steps.note: THE FIRST CLAIM: ] from the pill no longer steps to a box from its top into the small print under it; nothing bigger is an object, so it holds on the pill, 274 by 62
from the label, [ down to the words and ] twice back out lands on the pill, never past it into the small print
THE SECOND CLAIM: the picked measurement's outline and handles sit on the box it measured, 548 by 125 px, not out past its calipers and chips
THE THIRD CLAIM: the corner went where the hand let go, the calipers stayed on the box's bottom and right edges and read its new size, and the name followed: Size 334 × 105
one undo puts the measurement back as it was
an Option drag lands a copy exactly where the hand took the box, 150 points lower, not off by the calipers' margin
